---


### **Events:**
 - **node-clicked** - A node was clicked. `detail` is the node context (NodeRef).
- **node-double-click** - A node was double-clicked. `detail` is the node context.
- **copy** - A copy operation ran. `detail` is `{ operation, paths, nodes }`.
- **cut** - A cut operation ran. `detail` is `{ operation, paths, nodes }`.
- **paste** - A paste operation ran. `detail.result` is the PasteResult.
- **delete** - A delete operation ran. `detail` is the delete context.
- **node-drag-start** - A node drag started. `detail` is the drag context.
- **node-drag-over** - A node was dragged over. `detail` is the drag context.
- **node-drop** - A drop completed. `detail` is the NodeDropContext.
- **node-drag-denied** - A locked node was long-pressed / an undraggable drag was attempted. `detail` is the NodeRef.
- **node-drop-denied** - A drop was rejected by the target. `detail` is the NodeRef.
- **highlight-change** - The highlight set changed. `detail` is `{ paths, nodes }`.
- **selection-change** - The selection (checkbox) set changed. `detail` is `{ paths, nodes }`.
- **tree-changed** - The tree state changed (bulk notification; no detail).
- **focused-node-changed** - The focused node changed. `detail` is `{ focusedNode }`.

### **Methods:**
 
- **update(partial: _Partial<TreeViewConfig<T>>_): _void_** - Cosmetic/structural change — patch the live engine. Also serves as the
PUBLIC imperative `el.update(props)` method (the old API).

Sends the FULL assembled engine config on every call, exactly like the old
`_scheduleUpdate` → `treeview.update(buildConfig())` did. This matters:
`controller.updateProps` is a merge, and several derived behaviors (e.g.
`expandLevel` auto-expansion when `data` arrives) only fire when the relevant
keys are present together. A changed-keys-only partial would drop them.
Any explicit `partial` (imperative caller) is folded over the assembled config.


- **getTree(): _Ltree<T> | undefined_** - Access the underlying LTree for advanced programmatic usage.
- **getController(): _TreeController<T> | undefined_** - Access the TreeController directly.
- **getInsertResult()** - Result of the most recent insertArray (successful / failed / failedDetails).

### **CSS Properties:**
 - **--wtv-rem** - Base sizing unit for proportional scaling (default: 10px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-spacing-xs** - Extra small spacing (2px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-spacing-sm** - Small spacing (4px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-spacing-md** - Medium spacing (8px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-spacing-lg** - Large spacing (12px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-spacing-xl** - Extra large spacing (16px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-font-family** - Component font family (overrides --base-font-family) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-font-size-xs** - Extra small font (12px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-font-size-sm** - Small font (14px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-font-size-base** - Base font (16px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-font-size** - Default font size (= tv-font-size-sm) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-font-weight-medium** - Medium font weight _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-font-weight-semibold** - Semibold font weight _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-accent-color** - Primary accent color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-accent-color-hover** - Accent color on hover _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-text-color** - Primary text color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-text-color-2** - Secondary/muted text color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-text-color-on-accent** - Text on accent backgrounds _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-bg-color** - Main background color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-border-color** - Default border color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-success-color** - Success/valid drop color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-danger-color** - Danger/invalid drop color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-light-bg** - Elevated/subtle surface background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-hover-bg** - Hover background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-active-bg** - Active/pressed background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-selected-bg** - Selected node background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-selected-border-color** - Selected node border color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-selected-border** - Selected node border shorthand (2px solid accent) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-border-width-base** - Base border width (1px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-border** - Full border shorthand (1px solid border-color) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-bg-hover** - Node hover background (aliases tv-hover-bg) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-bg-active** - Node active/pressed background (aliases tv-active-bg) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-transition** - Node content transition (set to 'none' to disable hover animation) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-border-radius-sm** - Small border radius (4px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-border-radius-md** - Medium border radius (6px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-border-radius-lg** - Large border radius (8px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-transition-speed** - Fast transition duration (150ms) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-transition-normal** - Normal transition duration (200ms) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-easing** - Default easing curve _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-column-width** - Unified column width for toggle, icon, and indent step (24px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-indent-size** - Tree node indent per level (= tv-column-width) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-padding** - Node content padding _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-height** - Node row height (32px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-size** - Node icon size (16px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-toggle-size** - Toggle icon column size (= tv-column-width) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-toggle-color** - Toggle icon color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-expand** - Disclosure glyph mask (collapsed / the only glyph in rotate mode); chained to --base-icon-chevron. Re-pointed per icon-set. _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-collapse** - Disclosure glyph mask shown when expanded (swap mode only); chained to --base-icon-collapse for the plus-minus set. _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-leaf** - Optional leaf marker glyph mask (opt-in via leafIconClass=wtv__toggle-icon--leaf). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-rotate-collapsed** - Collapsed-state rotation for the disclosure glyph (0deg for a right-pointing chevron, -90deg for a down-caret). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-rotate-expanded** - Expanded-state rotation for the disclosure glyph (90deg for chevron). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-size-glyph** - Disclosure glyph mask box size (default 1em). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-check** - Checkmark glyph (mask) for a checked checkbox; chains to --base-icon-check. _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-indeterminate** - Dash glyph (mask) for a tri-state/partial checkbox; chains to --base-icon-indeterminate. _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-check-size** - mask-size of the check/dash glyph inside the box; chains to --base-icon-check-size (default 68%). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-size** - Checkbox box dimension (default 1.6×rem). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-scale** - Box/border/radius scale via calc (shared --base-checkbox-scale contract, no transform). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-border-width** - Checkbox box border thickness (hairline; multiplied by --wtv-checkbox-scale). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-border-color** - Unchecked checkbox box border color; chains to --base-checkbox-border-color. _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-border-radius** - Checkbox box corner radius (flat 0.3×rem, scaled by --wtv-checkbox-scale). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-bg** - Unchecked checkbox box background. _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-checked-bg** - Checked / indeterminate checkbox box background (defaults to the accent color). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-checked-border-color** - Checked / indeterminate checkbox box border color. _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-checked-bg-hover** - Checked / indeterminate checkbox background on hover (accent hover step). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-checkmark-color** - Check / dash glyph color (tints the mask). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-focus-ring-width** - Focus-ring thickness for a keyboard-focused checkbox. _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-focus-ring-color** - Focus-ring color for a keyboard-focused checkbox. _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-focus-ring** - Composed focus-ring box-shadow for a keyboard-focused checkbox. _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-glow-before-color** - Drop-before glow indicator color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-glow-after-color** - Drop-after glow indicator color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-glow-child-color** - Drop-as-child glow indicator color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-glow-before-bg** - Drop-before zone background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-glow-after-bg** - Drop-after zone background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-glow-child-bg** - Drop-as-child zone background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-glow-before-bg-active** - Drop-before zone active background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-glow-after-bg-active** - Drop-after zone active background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-glow-child-bg-active** - Drop-as-child zone active background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-glow-before-color-active** - Drop-before zone active text color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-glow-after-color-active** - Drop-after zone active text color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-glow-child-color-active** - Drop-as-child zone active text color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-glow-before-shadow** - Drop-before zone active box shadow _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-glow-after-shadow** - Drop-after zone active box shadow _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-glow-child-shadow** - Drop-as-child zone active box shadow _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-glow-before-text** - Drop-before zone default text color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-glow-after-text** - Drop-after zone default text color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-glow-child-text** - Drop-as-child zone default text color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-drag-over-bg** - Drag-over node background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-drag-over-border** - Drag-over node border _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-drag-over-glow-shadow** - Drag-over glow box shadow _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-drop-valid-bg** - Valid drop target background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-drop-valid-border-color** - Valid drop target border color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-drop-invalid-bg** - Invalid drop target background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-drop-invalid-border-color** - Invalid drop target border color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-dragover-highlight-bg** - Dragover highlight background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-dragover-highlight-border** - Dragover highlight border _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-touch-ghost-bg** - Touch drag ghost background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-touch-ghost-shadow** - Touch drag ghost box shadow _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-scroll-highlight-bg** - Scroll-to-node highlight background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-scroll-highlight-shadow** - Scroll-to-node highlight box shadow _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-dragged-opacity** - Opacity of dragged node (0.5) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-cut-opacity** - Opacity of cut nodes pending paste (0.4) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-context-menu-bg** - Context menu background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-context-menu-bg-hover** - Context menu item hover background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-context-menu-text-color** - Context menu text color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-context-menu-border** - Context menu border _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-context-menu-border-radius** - Context menu border radius _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-context-menu-shadow** - Context menu box shadow _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-context-menu-min-width** - Context menu minimum width (~150px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-context-menu-padding** - Context menu padding _(default: undefined)_

- **--wtv-context-menu-item-gap** - Gap between icon, label, shortcut _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-context-menu-icon-width** - Icon column width in context menu _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-context-menu-icon-font-size** - Icon font size in context menu _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-context-menu-arrow-font-size** - Submenu arrow font size _(default: undefined)_

attributes.name: tree-id
attributes.description: Stable identifier for this tree (clipboard / cross-tree operations).

attributes.name: id-member
attributes.description: Property name on a node object that holds its id.

attributes.name: path-member
attributes.description: Property name that holds a node materialized tree path.

attributes.name: display-value-member
attributes.description: Property name that holds a node display label.

attributes.name: display-value-fallback
attributes.description: Text shown for a node with no resolvable display value (default "[N/A]"; empty renders nothing).

attributes.name: parent-path-member
attributes.description: Property name holding a node parent path.

attributes.name: level-member
attributes.description: Property name holding a node depth level.

attributes.name: is-expanded-member
attributes.description: Property name flagging whether a node is expanded.

attributes.name: is-selected-member
attributes.description: Property name flagging whether a node is selected (checkbox).

attributes.name: is-draggable-member
attributes.description: Property name flagging whether a node is draggable.

attributes.name: is-drop-allowed-member
attributes.description: Property name flagging whether a drop is allowed onto a node.

attributes.name: has-children-member
attributes.description: Property name flagging that a node has children (lazy trees).

attributes.name: search-value-member
attributes.description: Property name a node is searched against.

attributes.name: is-selectable-member
attributes.description: Property name flagging whether a node can be selected.

attributes.name: is-collapsible-member
attributes.description: Property name flagging whether a node can be collapsed.

attributes.name: order-member
attributes.description: Property name used to order sibling nodes.

attributes.name: allowed-drop-positions-member
attributes.description: Property name listing the drop positions allowed on a node.

attributes.name: icon-member
attributes.description: Property name that holds a per-node icon.

attributes.name: expand-level
attributes.description: Depth to auto-expand on load (0 = roots only).

attributes.name: tree-path-separator
attributes.description: Separator between segments in a materialized tree path.

attributes.name: click-behavior
attributes.description: What a node click does: select, expand, or expand-and-focus.

attributes.name: accordion-expand
attributes.description: Accordion mode: expanding a node collapses its siblings.

attributes.name: is-sorted
attributes.description: Keep siblings sorted (by orderMember / sortCallback).

attributes.name: should-use-internal-search-index
attributes.description: Build an internal FlexSearch index for search.

attributes.name: indexer-batch-size
attributes.description: Nodes indexed per batch when building the search index.

attributes.name: indexer-timeout
attributes.description: Idle timeout (ms) between search-index batches.

attributes.name: search-text
attributes.description: Active search/filter term.

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: Force a `dark` / `light` theme (unset → follow host).

attributes.name: body-class
attributes.description: Extra class on the tree body container.

attributes.name: highlighted-node-class
attributes.description: Class applied to highlighted nodes.

attributes.name: focused-node-class
attributes.description: Class applied to the focused node.

attributes.name: drag-over-node-class
attributes.description: Class applied to a node being dragged over.

attributes.name: dragged-node-class
attributes.description: Class for the dragged source row; replaces the built-in .wtv__node-content--dragged visual.

attributes.name: icon-set
attributes.description: Disclosure glyph set: chevron (default) | triangle | plus-minus | arrow. Re-points the --wtv-icon-* variables via a :host([icon-set]) rule; reflected to the attribute so the CSS matches when set via the JS property.

attributes.name: expand-icon-class
attributes.description: DEPRECATED — use icon-set. Escape hatch: a custom class attached to the expandable toggle.

attributes.name: collapse-icon-class
attributes.description: DEPRECATED — glyph swap is now CSS-driven (icon-set + toggle-icon-mode); no longer selects the expanded glyph.

attributes.name: leaf-icon-class
attributes.description: Icon class for leaf nodes.

attributes.name: toggle-icon-mode
attributes.description: Whether the toggle glyph rotates (single glyph) or swaps (expand↔collapse glyph). Reflected to the attribute so the :host([toggle-icon-mode="swap"]) CSS matches via the JS property.

attributes.name: scroll-highlight-class
attributes.description: Class flashed on a node after scrollToPath().

attributes.name: scroll-highlight-timeout
attributes.description: How long (ms) the scroll highlight stays before clearing.

attributes.name: align-node-icons
attributes.description: Reserve a fixed icon column so node labels align.

attributes.name: context-menu-x-offset
attributes.description: Horizontal offset (px) of the context menu from the pointer.

attributes.name: context-menu-y-offset
attributes.description: Vertical offset (px) of the context menu from the pointer.

attributes.name: should-display-debug-information
attributes.description: Render in-tree debug diagnostics.

attributes.name: is-loading
attributes.description: Show the loading state.

attributes.name: drag-drop-mode
attributes.description: Drag-drop mode: `none` (off), `self` (within this tree), `cross` (between trees), or `both`.

attributes.name: drop-zone-mode
attributes.description: Drop-zone visual style: floating indicator or glow.

attributes.name: drop-zone-layout
attributes.description: Where drop zones render relative to a node.

attributes.name: drop-zone-start
attributes.description: Where drop zones begin. A number is a percentage of node width; a string is used as-is (`px` or `%`, e.g. "50px").

attributes.name: drop-zone-max-width
attributes.description: Maximum drop-zone width (px).

attributes.name: allow-copy
attributes.description: Allow the copy clipboard operation.

attributes.name: auto-handle-copy
attributes.description: Let the tree perform the copy itself (vs delegating to onCopy).

attributes.name: auto-handle-paste
attributes.description: Let the tree perform the paste itself (vs delegating to onPaste).

attributes.name: handle-keyboard-shortcuts
attributes.description: Handle copy/cut/paste/delete keyboard shortcuts.

attributes.name: touch-drag-delay
attributes.description: Long-press hold (ms) before a touch-drag engages (default 300).

attributes.name: indicate-undraggable
attributes.description: Built-in "can't move/drop this" feedback (🚫 badge + haptic). Default true.

attributes.name: enable-tree-drop-zone
attributes.description: Make the whole populated tree one drop target (drop lands target=null regardless of per-node drop rules).

attributes.name: no-data-text
attributes.description: Text shown when the tree is empty.

attributes.name: show-drop-placeholder-when-empty
attributes.description: Show a drop placeholder when the tree is empty.

attributes.name: use-flat-rendering
attributes.description: Render the visible nodes as a flat list (perf).

attributes.name: flat-indent-size
attributes.description: Indent size (CSS length) per level in flat rendering.

attributes.name: progressive-render
attributes.description: Render large trees in progressive batches.

attributes.name: initial-batch-size
attributes.description: Rows rendered in the first progressive batch.

attributes.name: max-batch-size
attributes.description: Maximum rows per progressive batch.

attributes.name: virtual-scroll
attributes.description: Enable virtual scrolling.

attributes.name: virtual-row-height
attributes.description: Fixed row height (px) used by virtual scrolling.

attributes.name: virtual-overscan
attributes.description: Extra rows rendered above/below the viewport when virtualizing.

attributes.name: virtual-container-height
attributes.description: Height (CSS length) of the virtual-scroll viewport.

attributes.name: range-selection-mode
attributes.description: How Shift+click range selection walks the tree.

attributes.name: selection-mode
attributes.description: Single- or multi-node selection.

attributes.name: show-checkboxes
attributes.description: Show a checkbox on each node.

attributes.name: checkbox-mode
attributes.description: Checkbox interaction: `independent` toggles one node; `cascade` toggles the subtree with a tristate box on branches.

attributes.name: cascade-select-policy
attributes.description: Which paths the selection EMITS in cascade mode: `rolled-up` (minimal cover), `leaves`, or `all`. Default rolled-up.

attributes.name: click-toggles-checkbox
attributes.description: A node-row click also toggles its checkbox.
